name: State-space representation
description: Linear time-invariant system representation: x_dot = A x + B u + y = C x + D u. Foundation for control theory + substrate-relevant dynamical state encoding.

name: Kalman filter
description: Optimal Bayesian state estimation for linear-Gaussian dynamical systems via recursive predict + update steps. Foundation for state estimation + substrate-relevant temporal-policy analogues.

name: Lyapunov stability theory
description: Stability analysis via Lyapunov function: V > 0 + V_dot < 0 implies asymptotic stability. Foundation for control theory + substrate-relevant Hopfield + cleanup convergence analysis.

name: PID control + feedback
description: Proportional-integral-derivative control loop: u = K_p e + K_i integral e + K_d de/dt. Foundation for control engineering + substrate-relevant feedback-loop analogues.

name: Linear quadratic regulator (LQR)
description: Optimal control for linear systems with quadratic cost via Riccati equation. Foundation for optimal control + substrate-relevant cost-minimization framework.

name: Dynamic programming (Bellman)
description: Optimization technique decomposing problems into recursive subproblems via Bellman equation. Foundation for sequential optimization + substrate-relevant Viterbi + Forward DP analogues.

name: Runge-Kutta methods (numerical ODE)
description: Fourth-order accurate numerical integration for ODE: RK4 update with weighted slope averages. Foundation for ODE solving + substrate-relevant dynamical-system simulation.

name: Conjugate gradient method
description: Iterative solver for symmetric positive-definite linear systems Ax=b. Foundation for numerical linear algebra + substrate-relevant fast linear solvers.

name: Levenberg-Marquardt algorithm
description: Damped least-squares method for nonlinear curve fitting: interpolates between Gauss-Newton + gradient descent. Foundation for nonlinear regression.

name: L-BFGS quasi-Newton
description: Limited-memory BFGS approximation to Newton's method. Foundation for medium-scale optimization + substrate-relevant fast convergence cells.

name: Sparse matrix techniques
description: Efficient storage + operations for matrices with mostly-zero entries: CSR + COO + sparse SVD. Foundation for substrate-relevant large-scale linear algebra.

name: Fast Fourier transform (FFT)
description: O(N log N) implementation of DFT via Cooley-Tukey divide-and-conquer. Foundation for signal processing + substrate FHRR circular convolution via convolution theorem.

name: Wavelet transform
description: Multi-resolution time-frequency analysis via wavelet basis. Foundation for signal processing + substrate-relevant multi-scale analysis.

name: Digital filter design (FIR/IIR)
description: Finite + infinite impulse response filters for signal processing. Foundation for signal filtering + substrate-relevant smoothing.

name: Spectral density estimation (Welch / periodogram)
description: Power spectral density via FFT-based methods. Foundation for signal analysis + substrate-relevant frequency-domain observability.

name: Cross-validation (k-fold)
description: Model evaluation via k-fold partitioning + average performance. Foundation for substrate empirical validation per method-overclaim rule.

name: Bootstrap resampling
description: Non-parametric statistical inference via resampling with replacement. Foundation for empirical confidence intervals per slot-filling multi-seed bootstrap.

name: Permutation test
description: Non-parametric hypothesis test via permuting labels + comparing test statistic to null distribution. Foundation for substrate empirical significance testing.

name: Bayes factor
description: Ratio of marginal likelihoods for Bayesian model comparison: BF_01 = p(D|M_0)/p(D|M_1). Foundation for Bayesian hypothesis testing.

name: Markov chain Monte Carlo (MCMC)
description: Sampling from probability distributions via Markov chain: Metropolis-Hastings + Gibbs + HMC. Foundation for Bayesian inference + substrate-relevant probabilistic computation.

name: Variational inference (VI)
description: Approximate Bayesian inference via optimization of evidence lower bound (ELBO). Foundation for scalable Bayesian inference + VAE.

name: Gaussian process (GP)
description: Distribution over functions defined by mean + covariance kernel. Foundation for Bayesian regression + Bayesian optimization.

name: Kernel methods (kernel trick)
description: Implicit feature mapping via kernel function K(x,y) = <phi(x), phi(y)>. Foundation for SVM + kernel ridge regression + substrate-relevant similarity analogues.

name: Random Fourier features
description: Approximation of kernel via random feature map + linear method. Foundation for scalable kernel methods + substrate-relevant random-projection analogues.

name: Normal forms (Chomsky + Greibach)
description: Canonical grammar forms for context-free grammars: Chomsky normal form + Greibach normal form. Foundation for parsing + substrate-relevant grammar manipulation.

name: CYK parser (Cocke-Younger-Kasami)
description: O(n^3) dynamic programming parser for context-free grammars in CNF. Foundation for parsing + substrate-relevant DP parsing.

name: Earley parser
description: O(n^3) parser handling arbitrary context-free grammars without CNF requirement. Foundation for general parsing.

name: Finite-state transducer (FST)
description: Finite automaton with input + output tapes. Foundation for morphology + phonology + substrate-relevant transduction.

name: Edit distance (Levenshtein)
description: Minimum number of insertions + deletions + substitutions to transform string A to B. Foundation for sequence alignment + spelling correction.

name: Needleman-Wunsch alignment
description: Global sequence alignment via dynamic programming for biological sequences. Foundation for bioinformatics + substrate-relevant sequence comparison.
